configurations.name: Pipeline: CMS CI/CD (manual dispatch)
configurations.command: gh workflow run ci-cms.yml --ref ${input:gitRef} -f environment=development && gh run list --workflow=ci-cms.yml --limit=1

configurations.name: Pipeline: Frontend CI/CD (manual dispatch)
configurations.command: gh workflow run ci-frontend.yml --ref ${input:gitRef} -f environment=development && gh run list --workflow=ci-frontend.yml --limit=1

configurations.name: Pipeline: Seed CMS Admin (development)
configurations.command: gh workflow run seed-cms-admin.yml --ref ${input:gitRef} -f environment=development && gh run list --workflow=seed-cms-admin.yml --limit=1

configurations.name: Pipeline: Seed CMS Admin (production)
configurations.command: gh workflow run seed-cms-admin.yml --ref ${input:gitRef} -f environment=production && gh run list --workflow=seed-cms-admin.yml --limit=1

configurations.name: Pipeline: Watch latest CMS run
configurations.command: gh run watch $(gh run list --workflow=ci-cms.yml --limit=1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId')

configurations.name: Pipeline: Watch latest Seed Admin run
configurations.command: gh run watch $(gh run list --workflow=seed-cms-admin.yml --limit=1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId')

inputs.description: Git ref to run workflow from (branch, tag, or SHA)
